caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic bell-shaped object with a lid, resembling a classical urn or a finial, suspended inside a symmetrical, arching bracket. The central object is rendered in shades of dark bronze or deep brown, with subtle highlights and shading that give it a three-dimensional appearance. The lid is dome-shaped and sits atop the urn-like form, and the base tapers outward slightly before ending in a round, flat knob. The bracket is attached on either side of the object near the upper third, curving gently downward and converging below the object, where a short, vertical rod-like projection extends downward. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there are a few small, scattered spots or marks visible on the paper. Near the bottom right of the object, faint text reads "E. L. A. L. ROG. ANDRON."
title: Fireman's Torch
